visual.description: Horizontal timeline with markers at 1950 (2.1M tons), 1980, 2010 (50M tons), and projected 2030 (75%). Timeline draws left-to-right with staggered marker reveals. Values in JetBrains Mono. '24× increase' callout text in Accent Pink between 1950 and 2010 markers. 2030 projection marker uses dashed style to indicate future estimate. Dot-grid background for data scene.

notes: First data scene of the video — sets the analytical tone. Timeline reveals sequentially from left to right. The '24x' annotation should appear after the 2010 marker lands. 2030 projection dashed to distinguish from historical data.
